actions.description: A seated duckling tests its balance inside the shell; its heavy head follows a beat late.
actions.label: Shell wiggle

actions.description: A slow sleepy head tuck, tiny wing cuddle and bright-eyed recovery; shell and feet stay planted.
actions.label: Sleepy nuzzle

actions.description: Two tentative weight shifts with a small lifted foot and wings spread for balance.
actions.label: Wobbly steps

actions.description: An eager two-beat wing clap with a delayed delighted head bob.
actions.label: Little claps

actions.description: A preschooler leans out, checks the other side and peeks above its visor.
actions.label: Curious peek

actions.description: An eager open-wing presentation, then a proud nod toward the player.
actions.label: Look what I found

actions.description: Lifts each heavy boot, plants it, and lets the coat and head absorb the landing.
actions.label: Rain-boot steps

actions.description: Crouches inside the raincoat, hops with both boots, then lands feet first.
actions.label: Boots together hop

actions.description: Tugs both shoulder straps, lifts the backpack with a shoulder shrug, then stands ready.
actions.label: Ready for school

actions.description: Sits into a small anticipation, raises one wing eagerly and leans forward to join in.
actions.label: I have an answer

actions.description: A controlled athletic reach to each side, counterbalanced by the head and planted sneakers.
actions.label: Side stretches

actions.description: Balances on one sneaker with outstretched wings, corrects a tiny wobble, then deliberately plants the foot.
actions.label: One-foot balance

actions.description: Loose alternating side steps with an independent head counter-beat and low, relaxed wings.
actions.label: Hoodie two-step

actions.description: Raises both shoulders, tilts the hooded head, then opens one wing in a playful invitation.
actions.label: Why not?

actions.description: Leans in for a closer look through the glasses, pauses to think, then tests an idea with a measured wing reach.
actions.label: Think it through

actions.description: A thoughtful downward glance resolves into a lifted head, one clear raised wing and a satisfied nod.
actions.label: An idea!

actions.description: Raises a wing toward the cap, scans deliberately, and points out a direction with an open wing.
actions.label: Scout the horizon

actions.description: A purposeful sneaker step, steady shoulder turn, then a small confident greeting.
actions.label: Ready to explore

actions.description: A headphone-inspired restrained groove: head nods lead, shoulders answer, and one sneaker taps.
actions.label: Find the rhythm

actions.description: A relaxed asymmetrical lean, brief wing salute and small nod, with no bouncy whole-body hop.
actions.label: Easy hello

actions.description: Attentive head tilt, a considered pause, then one deliberate reassuring nod; feet and bag stay settled.
actions.label: A thoughtful nod

actions.description: A composed open-wing invitation, gentle inclination toward the player and unhurried recovery.
actions.label: After you
